title: GRAD.------RT.ALGN.
description: Second diagram on page 235 (T(IMP)M-33). The crossing diagrams how gradualism structurally meets reality-alignment at the western-fixation scale: GRAD crossed with RT-ALGN. GRAD sits at left with the subject-arrow; RT-ALGN at right as partner-axis. CN-INFO (continuance-information) upper-center, CULT-INFO-B (cultural-information base) upper-right, INFO-TRNS (information transition) upper-right. (R)INTR (reality of introduction) center. AFN (affinity negation), APL-DT (applied dictates) right. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), CULT-AF-DT (cultural-affinity dictates), CULT-COD (cultural code) form the lower-left chain. POL-P (political particulars) right. Structural argument: gradualism reaches reality-alignment through the central (R)INTR hub; the upper chain CN-INFO -> CULT-INFO-B -> INFO-TRNS routes the form into cultural-information-transition; lower chain PROG-CONT -> CULT-AF-DT -> CULT-COD routes through cultural-code.
